purpose: Canonical full-replay test of preserving already-qualified stationary flash risk/prime across false raw disocclusion.
invariant: Production architecture 0 remained unchanged. Mode 18 preserved sequence state only under stationary current-surface correspondence; displayed history and moving/camera paths stayed conservative.
interpretation: Mode 18 strongly improves moving-flash suppression while keeping clearing and pan gates, but does not solve low-frequency uniform/quarter-field flashes. The perceptual phase split shows the remaining sequence-state path still depends on NVOFA current-surface confidence; uniform stationary flashes have no motion texture to provide that correspondence. The next test therefore treats absence of scene-level and local motion as stationary sequence correspondence for risk/prime only.
evidence_serialization: Repository copies are UTF-8 LF JSON serializations of the artifact JSON values.
